DOCKER_PLATFORM:
- linux/amd64
channel_sources:
- conda-forge
channel_targets:
- conda-forge main
docker_image:
- quay.io/condaforge/linux-anvil-x86_64:alma10
python_min:
- '3.11'

about.description:
sysLoss is a tool for analyzing power trees in systems, boards and circuits -
from the smallest IoT sensor to large industrial installations. The tool is
efficient and easy to use, the analysis result provides a detailed report on
voltages, currents, power, loss and efficiency for every component defined
in the system. sysLoss can interface to external battery models to estimate
battery life. Output format is Pandas DataFrame: Create charts, plots and
export to Excel and other formats. sysLoss can also produce graphical power
tree diagrams in a wide range of image formats.
about.summary: Power tree analysis of circuits, boards and systems.

name: sysloss
raw_meta_yaml:
{% set python_min = "3.11" %}
{% set name = "sysloss" %}
{% set version = "1.10.1" %}

package:
  name: {{ name|lower }}
  version: {{ version }}

source:
  url: https://files.pythonhosted.org/packages/source/{{ name[0] }}/{{ name }}/sysloss-{{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: ca6b5d68b43c4d441fe179eecfa9afe8c265b877c81be7f5b67cf8a77f4ba2ef

build:
  noarch: python
  script: {{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . -vv --no-deps --no-build-isolation
  number: 0

requirements:
  host:
    - python {{ python_min }}
    - poetry-core >=1.0.0
    - pip
  run:
    - python >={{ python_min }},<4.0.0
    - scipy >=1.9.0,<2.0.0
    - pandas >=2.0.0,<4.0.0
    - rustworkx >=0.13.0
    - rich >=12.0.0
    - toml >=0.10.2
    - matplotlib-base >=3.0.0,<4.0.0
    - tqdm >=4.63.0
    - packaging >=21.1
    - pydot >=3.0.0,<4.0.0
    - pillow >=13.0.0

test:
  imports:
    - sysloss
  commands:
    - pip check
  requires:
    - pip
    - python {{ python_min }}

about:
  home: https://github.com/geddy11/sysloss
  summary: Power tree analysis of circuits, boards and systems.
  description: |
    sysLoss is a tool for analyzing power trees in systems, boards and circuits - 
    from the smallest IoT sensor to large industrial installations. The tool is 
    efficient and easy to use, the analysis result provides a detailed report on 
    voltages, currents, power, loss and efficiency for every component defined 
    in the system. sysLoss can interface to external battery models to estimate 
    battery life. Output format is Pandas DataFrame: Create charts, plots and 
    export to Excel and other formats. sysLoss can also produce graphical power 
    tree diagrams in a wide range of image formats.
  license: MIT
  license_file: LICENSE
  doc_url: https://sysloss.readthedocs.io/
  dev_url: https://github.com/geddy11/sysloss


extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - geddy11
